content.json:
>**NOTE:** This workbook uses a parser based on a Kusto Function to normalize fields. [Follow these steps](https://aka.ms/sentinel-SlackAuditAPI-parser) to create the Kusto function alias **SlackAudit**.

## Prerequisites
Ensure the Slack audit data connector and the SlackAudit parser function are deployed in the same workspace before using this workbook. If the function or table is missing, queries will return no results.

content.query:
SlackAudit 
| extend evt_time = unixtime_seconds_todatetime(EventEndTime)
| where evt_time {TimeRange}
 | where Action startswith "user" | summarize count() by Action

 | extend evt_time = unixtime_seconds_todatetime(EventEndTime)
